description: Arsenal release increment policy. The self-publish publisher reads this one file at release time: a completed PHASE bumps the component named here once, a completed MISSION does the same, and cascade resets the lower components. Edit the numbers or swap the component to restyle the line; no script and no workflow hard-codes an increment. A malformed policy fails the release closed instead of guessing.
